title: Gatebraid project registration (gatebraid/project@1)
description: Registration record for a repository governed by Gatebraid, committed under projects/ in MianliWang/gatebraid. Registration is metadata only and confers no access: business repositories remain untouchable until a milestone explicitly authorizes work in them.

environment.description: Default execution environment for this project's Slices.

strict_gate.description: true = Strict Gate project (mandatory pre-release Codex adversarial review; per-project prohibited-operations overlay applies).

prohibited_operations_ref.description: Path (in this repo) to the project's prohibited-operations overlay document.
